programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Wenn ein Verdächtiger in Panik gerät und die Flucht ergreift, spürt der Hund das sofort. Eine einzige falsche Entscheidung führt zu einem sehr schnellen Ende. Der Polizeihund "Jax" nimmt die Verfolgung eines Verdächtigen auf, der des Autodiebstahls beschuldigt wird. "Bane" trägt dazu bei, eine mehrere Bundesstaaten umfassende Fahndung nach einem der meistgesuchten Verbrecher Philadelphias zu einem schockierenden Ende zu bringen. Nach einem Trauerzug beendet der Polizeihund "Timmy" eine angespannte Pattsituation, und "Jedi" macht seinen Hundeführer zum glücklichsten Polizisten der Truppe.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Die K9-Einheit übernimmt dort als Hundestaffel, wo Fahrzeuge nicht mehr weiterkommen. Am Valentinstag beendet Hund Igo eine angespannte Pattsituation, bevor sie eskaliert. Duder arbeitet mit einer befreundeten Hundestaffel-Einheit zusammen, um einen Verdächtigen so festzunehmen, dass er keine Fluchtmöglichkeit mehr hat. Chase macht seinem Namen alle Ehre. Und Apollo spürt innerhalb von Sekunden jemanden auf, der tief im dichten Gestrüpp vergraben ist.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Wenn Polizisten eine finale Warnung aussprechen, ist das die letzte Chance, sich zu ergeben - entweder kapitulieren oder dem Hund entgegentreten. "Scout" stößt frontal mit einem bewaffneten Verdächtigen zusammen, der sich weigert, zurückzuweichen, und der Polizeihund "Vlad" stellt sich einem trotzigen Fahrer entgegen, der den Anweisungen nicht Folge leistet. Mitten in der Nacht spürt "Edge" zwei flüchtende mutmaßliche Diebe auf und bringt sie zur Strecke, während "ZAM" methodisch eine Fahrzeugdurchsuchung durchführt und dabei eine ganze Reihe von Anklagepunkten aufdeckt.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Jede Suche hat ein Ergebnis. Ob es darum geht, eine vermisste Person zu finden oder einen flüchtigen Verdächtigen zu verfolgen - ein Polizeihund sorgt dafür, dass die Suche mit Antworten endet. "Pandora" verschwendet keine Zeit und bringt einer verzweifelten Familie, die nach einem Angehörigen sucht, Erlösung. Die Polizeihunde "Jet" und "Cheney" jagen gemeinsam einen Flüchtigen, der über die Straße rast und sich weigert anzuhalten. "Karma" bringt einen aggressiven Mann zum Aufgeben, der sich der Festnahme widersetzt. Und "Endo" folgt der Fährte direkt zu einem Müllcontainer.

programme.title: Teuflische Nachbarn
programme.desc: Eine Familie wird in ihrer Ruhe gestört, als ein lauter Nachbar in die Wohnung direkt über ihr einzieht. Der Konflikt entbrennt auf beiden Seiten und führt zu fliegenden Fäusten, gezogenen Waffen und endet mit einem Mann, der blutend im Hausflur liegt.

programme.title: Cold Case Files - Der Grim Sleeper
programme.desc: Dieses Special befasst sich mit den Verbrechen des berüchtigten Serienmörders Lonnie Franklin jr., der sich 25 Jahre lang an Frauen in South Central Los Angeles verging. Die packende Geschichte eines wahren Verbrechens wird mit der realen Geschichte der Suche nach einem schwer fassbaren Mörder und dem Kampf für Gerechtigkeit in einer Gemeinde in Los Angeles verwoben.

programme.title: Cold Case Files - Der Grim Sleeper
programme.desc: Im Los Angeles der 1980er Jahre terrorisiert ein Mörder den Stadtteil South Central. Er ermordet afroamerikanische Frauen und entsorgt ihre Leichen auf der Straße. Die Zahl der Opfer steigt - Verdächtige gibt es nur wenige - und Angst und Wut machen sich breit in einer Gemeinde, die von der Polizei oft übersehen wird.

programme.title: Steven Lorenzo - Tampas Serienmörder
programme.desc: In dieser Folge werden die Ereignisse des Wochenendes beleuchtet, an dem Steven und Scott zweimal töteten. Sie fanden ihre Opfer Jason und Michael in einem Schwulenclub in Tampa. Die Mütter von Jason und Michael kämpften 20 Jahre lang für Gerechtigkeit und erhielten sie schließlich im Jahr 2023. Doch es stellte sich heraus, dass die Morde an Jason und Michael nur die Spitze des Eisbergs waren. Die Ermittler fanden Tausende von Fotos von unbekannten Männern, die bewusstlos, gefesselt und geknebelt waren. Hätte Steven Lorenzo früher gestoppt werden können?

programme.title: Steven Lorenzo - Tampas Serienmörder
programme.desc: Angehörige vermisster Männer in Florida beginnen zu glauben, dass Steven Lorenzo seit Jahren mordet, obwohl die Polizei ihn nicht eindeutig mit den Verbrechen in Verbindung bringen kann. Ein Detective hat von Anfang an in diesem Fall ermittelt und für Gerechtigkeit für all diese Männer gekämpft. Auf Lorenzos Festplatte fanden die Ermittler drei Bilder von Männern, die alle augenscheinlich tot waren. Steven hatte die Bilder mit "Bobby.

programme.desc: Eine junge Mutter aus Savannah wird erschossen vor der Haustür eines Nachbarn aufgefunden, und die Ermittler decken eine erschreckende Wendung auf: Ihre neugeborenen Zwillinge wurden von einer Frau entführt, die sie in einer Müttergruppe kennengelernt hatte. programme.title: Witness to Murder - Digitale Zeugen
programme.desc: Die Familie einer vermissten Mutter aus Texas macht sich Sorgen, als sie verdächtige Textnachrichten von ihrem Telefon erhält. Jahrelang bleibt der Fall ungelöst, doch eine Reihe von digitalen Hinweisen hilft den Ermittlern schließlich, einen überzeugenden Fall gegen den Mörder der Mutter aufzubauen.

programme.title: Im Angesicht
programme.desc: Als Eva Habermann Fanpost von einem scheinbar älteren Herrn erhielt, dachte sie sich anfangs nicht viel dabei. Doch als der Absender die Zufahrt zu ihrem Haus versperrte, um seine Liebe zu offenbaren, merkte die Schauspielerin, dass die Zuneigung problematische Züge annahm. Der damals 21-jährige Stalker ging so weit, dass er hinter dem Haus ihrer Wohnung campierte, Sturm klingelte und nachts Steinchen gegen das Fenster warf - bis Habermann wieder bei ihren Eltern einzog. In "Im Angesicht" berichtet sie von ihren Erfahrungen und sagt: "Was es in mir ausgelöst hat, ist eine größere Wachsamkeit.".

programme.title: Fentanyl - Hollywoods tödlicher Rausch
programme.desc: Ein schonungsloser Blick auf die Fentanyl-Krise und ihre tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen auf unsere Gesellschaft und Kultur. Von prominenten Persönlichkeiten und Künstlern wie Prince, Angus Cloud, Tom Petty, Michael K. Williams bis hin zu Familien aus allen Gesellschaftsschichten sterben jedes Jahr mehr als 70.000 Amerikaner an einer Fentanyl-Vergiftung. Die zweistündige Sondersendung, moderiert von Ice T, berichtet über die schrecklichen Folgen und die herzzerreißenden Geschichten derjenigen, die direkt von dieser tödlichen Substanz betroffen sind.

programme.title: Taskforce Kinderschutz - Verbrechen im Netz
programme.desc: Als die unangemessenen Nachrichten eines Lehrers an einen Minderjährigen ans Licht kommen, setzt sich Detective Godwin dafür ein, das Ausmaß seiner Verbrechen aufzudecken. Dann führt die verzerrte Auffassung eines Sexualstraftäters von Liebe zu einer dramatischen Festnahme. Die Ermittler nehmen einen Sexualstraftäter fest, der sowohl Jungen als auch Mädchen ins Visier nimmt.

programme.title: Taskforce Kinderschutz - Verbrechen im Netz
programme.desc: Ein Sexualstraftäter, der Pornografie an Minderjährige weitergibt, löst ein Katz-und-Maus-Spiel mit Tonys Team aus. Dann identifiziert eine verdeckte FBI-Ermittlung einen Mann, der es auf eine 10-Jährige abgesehen hat. Tony nimmt einen Sexualstraftäter mit perversen Rollenspiel-Fantasien fest.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: In Tulsa gerät ein nächtliches Treffen außer Kontrolle, wodurch ein junger Vater stirbt, sein Freund lebensgefährlich verletzt wird und ihr Geländewagen in das Schlafzimmer eines Kindes rast.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Auf einem ruhigen Bauerndorf wird "Rico" eingesetzt, um einen Mann aufzuspüren, der beschuldigt wird, seinen Nachbarn erwürgt zu haben. Unterdessen wird "Clooney" eingesetzt, als ein Verdächtiger versucht, einen Polizeiwagen zu stehlen, um in einem letzten verzweifelten Versuch zu fliehen. Während eines heftigen Kampfes ist der Hundeführer von "Bane" gezwungen, ihn mithilfe einer automatischen Türentriegelung für schnelle Einsätze ferngesteuert einzusetzen. Und "Mari" spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei einer der größten Kokainbeschlagnahmungen in ihrer Region.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Kurz vor ihrer Pensionierung wird "Tasja" in ein Hotel mit über 140 Zimmern geschickt - endlose Verstecke und ein Verdächtiger, der sich einfach nicht finden lässt. "Midnight" soll einen vermissten Jungen finden. Er ist zwar auf das Aufspüren von Betäubungsmitteln trainiert, hat aber bei der Suche nach vermissten Personen eine Erfolgsquote von vier von vier. Unterdessen eskaliert eine Verkehrskontrolle, als "Raider" eine Reaktion auf Drogen zeigt. Mitten in der Nacht verfolgt "Jet" einen Verdächtigen, der unter Alkoholeinfluss fährt, bevor dieser weiteren Schaden anrichten kann.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Zusammen mit FBI-Agenten und der Strafvollzugsbehörde spürt der Polizeihund "Eddie" einen Verdächtigen auf, gegen den ein Haftbefehl vorliegt. Unterdessen legt "Jax" sofort los und sucht nach einem Verdächtigen, der des Diebstahls eines Pick-ups beschuldigt wird. "Dundee" wird zur Verfolgung eines Verdächtigen eingesetzt, der mit einem Transporter direkt in ein Fitnessstudio gerast ist und dabei erheblichen Schaden angerichtet hat. Und trotz eines hochmodernen Überwachungssystems wird "Koda" hinzugezogen, um das zu tun, was die Technik nicht kann: der Fährte folgen und den Verdächtigen aufspüren.

programme.title: Im Angesicht
programme.desc: "Bist du der Sohn vom neuen Bullen?" - Als Sohn eines Polizisten wuchs Helmut Zierl gut behütet in schleswig-holsteinischer Idylle auf. Weil er in der Schule mit Haschisch handelte, schmiss ihn der Vater zuhause raus. Zierl schlug sich bis nach Brüssel und Amsterdam durch, lebte auf der Straße und sammelte Erfahrungen im Drogen- und Sektenmilieu; eine für ihn prägende Zeit, in der der Tod ein ständiger Begleiter gewesen sei. "Wenn einem mit 16 Jahren innerhalb von drei Monaten vier Menschen, die man lieb gewonnen hatte, wegsterben, dann ist das ein Schock fürs Leben. Ich kriege die Bilder nicht mehr aus dem Kopf." Schließlich kehrte Zierl in die Heimat zurück, "weil ich damit völlig überfordert war". Später wurde er zu einem der gefragtesten Schauspieler Deutschlands.

programme.desc: Auf einem ruhigen Bauerndorf wird "Rico" eingesetzt, um einen Mann aufzuspüren, der beschuldigt wird, seinen Nachbarn erwürgt zu haben. Unterdessen wird "Clooney" eingesetzt, als ein Verdächtiger versucht, einen Polizeiwagen zu stehlen, um in einem letzten verzweifelten Versuch zu fliehen. Während eines heftigen Kampfes ist der Hundeführer von "Bane" gezwungen, ihn mithilfe einer automatischen Türentriegelung für schnelle Einsätze ferngesteuert einzusetzen. Und "Mari" spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei einer der größten Kokainbeschlagnahmungen in ihrer Region.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Kurz vor ihrer Pensionierung wird "Tasja" in ein Hotel mit über 140 Zimmern geschickt - endlose Verstecke und ein Verdächtiger, der sich einfach nicht finden lässt. "Midnight" soll einen vermissten Jungen finden. Er ist zwar auf das Aufspüren von Betäubungsmitteln trainiert, hat aber bei der Suche nach vermissten Personen eine Erfolgsquote von vier von vier. Unterdessen eskaliert eine Verkehrskontrolle, als "Raider" eine Reaktion auf Drogen zeigt. Mitten in der Nacht verfolgt "Jet" einen Verdächtigen, der unter Alkoholeinfluss fährt, bevor dieser weiteren Schaden anrichten kann.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Zusammen mit FBI-Agenten und der Strafvollzugsbehörde spürt der Polizeihund "Eddie" einen Verdächtigen auf, gegen den ein Haftbefehl vorliegt. Unterdessen legt "Jax" sofort los und sucht nach einem Verdächtigen, der des Diebstahls eines Pick-ups beschuldigt wird. "Dundee" wird zur Verfolgung eines Verdächtigen eingesetzt, der mit einem Transporter direkt in ein Fitnessstudio gerast ist und dabei erheblichen Schaden angerichtet hat. Und trotz eines hochmodernen Überwachungssystems wird "Koda" hinzugezogen, um das zu tun, was die Technik nicht kann: der Fährte folgen und den Verdächtigen aufspüren.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: "Tipster" begegnet einem alten Bekannten - einem Wiederholungstäter, der sich nur allzu gut an ihre letzte Begegnung erinnert. "Murphy.

programme.title: Teuflische Nachbarn
programme.desc: Eine alleinstehende Frau und ihre beiden kleinen Söhne glauben, eine perfekte neue Wohnung gefunden zu haben, aber ihr penetranter Vermieter und Nachbar verwandelt ihre idyllische Situation bald in eine wahre Hölle, die schließlich mit Blutvergießen endet.

programme.title: Witness to Murder - Digitale Zeugen
programme.desc: Die Ermittler in Aurora, Colorado, sammeln wichtige Informationen über einen Doppelmord aus dem Material von Überwachungskameras in der Nachbarschaft, können den Mörder aber erst identifizieren und aufspüren, als einige wichtige digitale Daten aufgedeckt werden.

programme.title: Witness to Murder - Digitale Zeugen
programme.desc: Die Familie einer vermissten Mutter aus Texas macht sich Sorgen, als sie verdächtige Textnachrichten von ihrem Telefon erhält. Jahrelang bleibt der Fall ungelöst, doch eine Reihe von digitalen Hinweisen hilft den Ermittlern schließlich, einen überzeugenden Fall gegen den Mörder der Mutter aufzubauen.

programme.title: Fentanyl - Hollywoods tödlicher Rausch
programme.desc: Ein schonungsloser Blick auf die Fentanyl-Krise und ihre tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen auf unsere Gesellschaft und Kultur. Von prominenten Persönlichkeiten und Künstlern wie Prince, Angus Cloud, Tom Petty, Michael K. Williams bis hin zu Familien aus allen Gesellschaftsschichten sterben jedes Jahr mehr als 70.000 Amerikaner an einer Fentanyl-Vergiftung. Die zweistündige Sondersendung, moderiert von Ice T, berichtet über die schrecklichen Folgen und die herzzerreißenden Geschichten derjenigen, die direkt von dieser tödlichen Substanz betroffen sind.

programme.title: Daryl Hall & John Oates
programme.sub-title: Hall & Oates - Live at Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: When Daryl Hall and John Oates took to the stage at Sydney's Entertainment Centre as the iconic bass line of ‘Maneater' began to play, the fans knew they were in for a treat. This duo may have been opening concerts with that irresistibly smooth number for years, but it never seems to lose its magic, and the crowd – an eclectic mix of teens and baby boomers alike – lapped it up. Daryl Hall and John Oates wisely reunited a few years ago after a string of solo projects, and although Oates no longer sports his signature ‘tache, they put on the kind of show that makes it hard to believe they even considered going their separate ways. Earworms like ‘I Can't Go For That', ‘Out Of Touch' and ‘Kiss On My List' were surefire reminders that these guys are absolute hit machines, and their catchy synth-soul classics probably deserve to permeate the airwaves as much today as they did decades ago. These Philly crooners still have it in bucket-loads, so this show should have everyone from diehard Daryl Hall and John Oates fans to kids of the 80's groovin' along in no time.

programme.desc: On the plains of Amboseli, the rains are two months late. Echo brings the family to the palms to eat the last leaves. The wise matriarch resists the temptation to take them to inhabited areas where fresh crops are springing up and conflict waits.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli
programme.desc: In the relentless drought, the youngest calves are starving. Hunger is driving elephants to forage on surrounding farms. Echo's keeps her family to the swamp. Rains arrive, but after five days, the much-needed downpours dwindle to sparse showers.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli
programme.desc: The rains bring new life. Lush new grass is saving the 58 elephant families from hunger. An extraordinary annual reunion brings hundreds of elephants together in scenes of celebration, play and romance.

programme.title: Blue Realm

programme.title: Modern Migrations
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on the dynamics of the driving force of natural migrations. The seasonal movement of wild animals between pastures is a natural phenomenon, but not everywhere.

programme.title: Ireland
programme.sub-title: the Emerald Isle Rediscovered - S1 E04

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: It's a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase plateau are dramatic scenes of wonder formed from rock. The Pajute Indians once described Bryce Canyon as: “red rocks standing like men in a basin”.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: Journey Within

We finally got a longbeard to commit, and we made it count just before time ran out. This is one of those hunts that reminds you why we do it.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.
Adam and Logan Hays chase big bucks in the Buckeye State!

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.
Follow Adam Hays as he hunts for his 5th 200 Inch deer in his home state of Ohio.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: Join Austin as he tries to track down his target buck on his home property in Pennsylvania.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is in Oklahoma at the Dirty Bird ranch trying to take down a buck with his new Thompson Center Muzzleloader.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Join Bryan Brown, Rigsby Stewart, and Chase Herndon along with Lee Ellis on our annual opening week hunt in Northern Nebraska. Big Bucks were spotted and a tag was punched on an unexpected buck on opening day!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Contributor Josh Honeycutt breaks down the profound impact of hunting mentorship, exploring why it is equally vital to guide the next generation and to have a mentor of your own. The episode highlights the true reward of these bonds by showcasing a memorable hunt where Josh's guidance and mentorship make a massive, life-changing impact on a young hunter.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he travels deeper into the rugged terrain of the Eastern Cape. In this episode, he is in pursuit of one of Africa’s most challenging and elusive plains game species, the Cape Bushbuck. Known for their ability to vanish into thick vegetation at the first sign of danger, hunting these "ghosts of the bush" requires extreme patience and precision. Join the crew as they navigate the dense brush and steep hillsides, battling shifting winds and thick cover to find a mature ram.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along as Mark Peterson travels to Tanzania to hunt the Eastern and Western White-Bearded Wildebeest. These animals are known for their distinctive white beards and large horns, making them a sought-after trophy for hunters on an African safari. Mark sets out on an exciting and thrilling adventure to track down these elusive creatures in the plains of Tanzania.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This week we are rolling along side the crew from Double T Outfitters. Management plays a huge role in every outfitters success every year. Bret and his team have a strong management plan in place and these guys had a blast with a group of out of state hunters.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and the new producer (Tim Guidroz) go out on their first turkey hunt together, and even though the weather is not ideal, they get the job done on a Wilkinson County gobbler. We also get a look at what the United Country - Southern States Realty office looks like during turkey season, with interviews from Scott Lindsey and Caleb Armstrong, and three big properties closing in Baton Rouge.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team take a look into enhanced storage and utility options from Boat Outfitters like cooler slides, tackle storage and CoolerWebs . They also tackle applying Tuff-coat paint to the Aquasport project and showcase how easy it is to apply.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team follows the project of a detailed retrofitting of a Bertram upgrading from one motor to twin engines with the help of an Armstrong Bracket. The team then heads to Boatwrench Inc. to rebuild the carburetor for the Glastron project.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we take you to historic Saint Francisville, Louisiana. We closed on a couple of real estate properties in this area and want to show you why this area is so unique from a recreational standpoint. This place holds the “old south” feel that is ever so fleeting. We hunt on a property I sold to a client last year in Saint Francisville and manage to get a beautiful longbearded turkey on the ground. This episode is one you definitely don’t want to miss.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive into how we are using our knowledge and experience to not only get some amazing hunting property, but to have other people pay for it. Sound too good to be true? - We also take you on some great hunts we’ve had on our journey flipping land and think back on some memories from the past and what the future is going to look like. - We hope you can learn a thing or two in this episode and encourage you to reach out with any questions you may have about this process.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade takes you on a ride through one of the coolest cities in the south, the historic Natchez, Mississippi. This is an area in which Slade sells a lot of hunting land and being only 40 minutes from where he grew up, Slade is very familiar with all there is to do in the area not only from a recreational standpoint but also for entertainment. Slade takes you through the showing process on a beautiful piece of property and bring it full circle at the closing. You’ll also watch a deer hunt with Slade in Natchez that was featured on Realtree Monster Bucks DVD. This is a jampacked episode with so much to learn and also enjoy. We know you’ll love it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade gives you the grand tour of his home property. Slade’s dream was the same as many others, have a place where he can build a home, raise a family, and also have plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors and chase big rack bucks. Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade goes over what he’s doing at his home property to create summer food plots for deer, and gives tips to those looking to do the same. - On the final hunt for the 2024 season, Lori gets a big Wilkinson County gobbler.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: WWII U.S. Navy veteran Bill Kruschel recounts a journey from humble beginnings in the midst of the Great Depression to his valuable service in the Navy, culminating in a lifelong commitment to the field of special education.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Don Weber recounts his amazing journey through survivors guilt, PTSD and starting over.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Carlos Powell tells of family sacrifice and fighting his post service “demons.”

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Denny McMahan on this episode at the legendary Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas. Denny was nominated by his wife for Bucks for the Brave program hosted by Trinity Oaks. After dedicating his life to service in the US Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy. Denny is a true hero in his community - someone who sacrifices his time, his well being, and his life in service to others, never asking for anything in return.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Jennifer Brooks has spent her life answering the call to serve. From flying Blackhawk helicopters on multiple combat missions during two tours in Iraq to now serving as an Air Medical Pilot and first responder, her story is one of courage, sacrifice, and humility. In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: The bond between and parent and child can grow in many ways, but nothing compares to the bond shared when hunting. The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters has becoming a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin and in 2021, Gavin was able to take his largest buck to date, with his dad Heath behind the camera.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen. Jimmy settles in at the G2 Ranch in South Texas, where prime whitetail country and a shared passion for the outdoors set the stage for an unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We find ourselves fishing with Troy from Lonestar Beer. Not only is Troy a great friend he is also a big supporter of Hunters Extravaganza. We get to catch up in the offseason and spend a day on the water discussing future events and reflect on what all Texas has to offer.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: With over 20 years of service, retiring as a Senior Chief Machinery Technician, Steven served abord multiple Coast Guard cutters, led critical missions, protected our nation's leaders, and earned the Coast Guard Achievement Medal for his outstanding service. Beyond the uniform, Steven has has spent decades giving back - coaching youth sports, mentoring young athletes, and living the values of service, leadership, and integrity. Steven's dedication didn't end with retirement - and neither does our gratitude. We were honored to have Steven at Thumbtack Ranch and are even more grateful for his service.

After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: When an accident sends a solar flare four times larger than Earth plunging toward the planet, Military scientist Dr. Jane Brandt calls upon the one man who can possibly reverse the cataclysm: a government outsider and renegade ad-hoc scientist. He’ll have to work fast, as in a matter of hours, the planet’s atmosphere will ignite and the countdown to the end of the world will begin.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Master filmmaker Sidney Lumet (The Verdict, Dog Day Afternoon, Serpico) delivers "one of his greatest achievements" (Roger Ebert) with this riveting and compelling suspense thriller.
